blocks.text: 按依赖启动和释放资源，把插件安装、加载产物与运行中回调交给同一条可观察的生命周期。

items: 服务先于配置启动，退出时配置又先被关闭：资源先后只靠数组位置和分散的 finally。
提供者暂时未就绪，服务却永远停在旧状态：反复读取旧快照，没有区分 blocked 和最终失败。
插件先于依赖到达，半就绪能力就被公开：登记定义与真正安装没有分开。
插件转换失败后资源没释放，安装成功后却被提前释放：加载、转换和安装各自管理清理。
调用已经取消，回调却仍在使用资源：停止等待被误当成代码已经结束。
依赖顺序同时决定启动与释放。 静态资源图复用 Capability Graph，先启动依赖，再按反序释放服务 在反向登记后仍先启动配置、先释放服务。
临时阻塞可以显式恢复，最终失败保持稳定。 readiness getter 只在 blocked 后重新采样，仅重试暂时阻塞的就绪门 同时核对了零提前启动与 failed Promise 缓存。
插件定义可以等待缺失依赖。 托管 Host 通过 Feature 引用保留 blocked 定义，等待提供者安装后再启用依赖插件 展示提供者到达后启动、移除后再次阻塞。
加载资源按提交结果交接清理责任。 loadIntoHost 暂管加载产物并按 committed 转给插件，提交成功后才交接加载制品的清理责任 核对成功后延后释放与转换失败回滚。
取消不提前释放回调仍在使用的资源。 Runtime 保留当前安装资源的使用权直到真实结算，取消后仍等待回调实际结束 在信号中止后仍观察到一个运行，回调完成后才归零。

blocks.text: Tray 组合已有的能力与生命周期，不另建一套协议。静态 Graph 管理同一运行环境内、构造前已知的完整资源集合；托管 Host 组合 PluginHost 定义；根入口的 Hosts 注册表管理独立实例。能力依赖由 capability 负责，插件安装由 plugin-host 负责，连接和原生执行由 RPC / supervision 负责；这些依赖图不等于响应式数据依赖。

blocks.text: Loader、Adapter、Runtime 不从根入口聚合。直接导入 plugin-host、lifecycle 等依赖的示例应直接安装这些包。本包运行时依赖 capability、event-subscriber、lifecycle、plugin-host、rpc-contract、rpc-core、rpc-process、rpc-threads、supervision 与 utils。跨机器发现、浏览器 Worker 接入、UI、持久消息与自动故障转移重试不属于这里的组合保证。
`createTrayGraph(entries)` 必填一个完整只读数组，构造时同步检查但不启动。ITrayKey 是带品牌的字符串，运行时要求 trim 后非空；业务应集中定义并复用键，不依赖库猜测或生成。

blocks.text: key、kind、requires、readiness、start 的入场读取与依赖检查都在第一个 start 之前；异常或外形非法为 TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY。规范化后的 keys / requires 数组冻结，调用方后续修改原数组不会改变拓扑。readiness 属性值在入场捕获，首次 gate 使用该对象；这不是对任意业务值或快照对象做深克隆。

context.signal 在 Graph 关闭时中止；context.get(key) 只读取已声明、已就绪的直接依赖；context.own(resource, descriptor) 把辅助资源交给当前节点，完整 release descriptor 沿 lifecycle 处理。start 的主值 release(context) 接收 Graph 释放上下文，可同步返回或返回类 Promise 对象。部分构造失败时，entry 自己回滚尚未交出的资源。

第一次 ready() 按 entry 顺序检查入场捕获快照的 state / error；全缺省或 ready 才启动 Graph。blocked / failed 拒绝其 error，null / undefined 时使用 TRAY_UNAVAILABLE，其他假值仍是原失败。非法 state 为 TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY，之后不读取该快照的 error；getter 失败尽可能保留原生类型 / identity 并附 TRAY_GATE_READ_FAILED。
只有 blocked 允许下一次显式 ready() 重新读取各 entry.readiness 及新快照；提供 getter 才能取得提供者后来发布的新对象。failed、非法快照、getter 失败及 Graph 启动结果缓存同一个 Promise；启动成功后不再采样外部门，dispose 后不再重试。没有自动轮询或重试计时。

ready 前为 open；gate 失败投影 failed，之后沿 Graph 状态与原错误。

blocks.text: `await createHost(options)` 只从 /host 导入；create() 构造唯一 concrete PluginHost class 实例或 defineHost() handle，facade 继续使用原 Host 身份、domain core、pipeline 和 constructor baseline。插件 install(core) 接收 domain core 与 lifecycle core，不接收 Host handle。

rows: 必填函数，无默认，返回尚未被其他 Tray 会话认领的原 Host。
必填初始定义 tuple，无默认；一起入场并按 Feature 依赖启动。

必填，无默认；有限非负预算，用于 bounded 的物理清理等待。
必填，无默认；bounded 或 strict-drain。

blocks.text: Tray 使用同一份 PluginHost admission 快照的 Feature、config 与 disposer，通过公开依赖读取器建立动态图，再发布已就绪定义。必需 provider 缺失时 definition 保留 blocked；可选 provider 缺失不阻塞，存在时也先于使用者安装。依赖来自 Feature references，不接受旧插件依赖字段。无效描述子在图变更前拒绝，PluginHost 原错保留 cause；进入图变更后的失败按 mutation result 观察。

增加 definition，缺 provider 时可 committed 且 blocked。
替换同名 exact generation，保留原排序位置。
删除 definition 并阻塞使用者闭包；未知名返回 ok true / committed false / removed false。

blocks.text: 失败结果的 committed 表示候选是否已经成为当前 binding，不能用 ok 或“同名还存在”猜测。未提交 duplicate / cycle / replacement 候选回滚，不成为后来重启的隐式来源。真正 unUse 后原排序位置永久退休，同名后续 use 获得新的单调位置；provider 恢复与同名 replace 保留已有 definition 的位置。

成功结果携带 result.view；检查 ok 后把该 view 交给 createRuntime，才能延续新插件精确扩展类型。原 Host 变量的静态类型不会自动改变。ITrayResolvedHost 对有限、literal、最多 128 个定义且 provider/name 未泛化的 tuple 求 ready 闭包；超出预算或名称泛化使用 ITrayHostDynamic，保留 constructor baseline，未知动态键为 unknown。

Host.state 可为 active / closing / terminal / failed；失败时 facade.state 可为 failed，而返回清理结果仍标记 state terminal。工厂失败的 creation detail 带阶段与清理信息；phase 类型包含 factory / admission / graph / setup / commit，当前实际观察路径使用 factory / setup，不承诺逐项发出所有阶段。重复认领已在使用的 Host 只回滚本次 claim，不销毁已有会话；冻结 factory 异常通过 cause 保留，避免 detail 附加覆盖原错。绕过 facade 使用逃逸的 concrete Host 变更，会以 HOST_MUTATION_BYPASS 关闭后续可信访问。

Host mutation / disposal 的 ICleanupResult 来自 lifecycle：cleanupErrors 是当前快照，cleanupComplete false 表示仍需观察同一个 physicalCompletion，其结果只包含后来新增的错误。用 `mergeCleanupResults([result])` 合并当前及所有后续增量，包括跨运行环境的 Promise。

Graph 在释放 exact generation 前封闭该 binding 的新使用权，再等已取得使用权的工作结束；PluginHost 先等待这道屏障，再按使用者 / 提供者、插件 / 资源顺序清理。Host 的 bounded 可按 quiescenceMs 返回逻辑结果，strict-drain 等实际完成。原 PluginHost 必填 execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 为数值时，共享本批预算到期后继续后续清理；false 才逐项等真实完成。预算不会取消仍在运行的 Promise，迟到工作与错误继续由 physicalCompletion 观察。
托管 Host 支持异步显式资源管理；环境不支持 await using 时，在 finally 中 await host.dispose()。不要把 cleanupComplete false 当成全部资源已释放，也不要丢弃物理结果。

defineLoader({ load }) 捕获一次 load 方法，返回冻结合同；每次 load(source, context) 调用该函数一次，接受同步、Promise 与外来类 Promise 对象。defineAdapter({ adapt }) 同样捕获转换方法并在每次 adapt 时调用；它们不创建 Host / Graph，也不独自接管制品清理。独立包装器保留执行结果，事务中的失败分类由 loadIntoHost 负责。
load 的结果须含 value 与 lifecycle release descriptor，至少有可调用 force；与静态 entry 的 release 函数不是同一外形。adapter 将 value 转成与原 Host core 兼容的插件描述子。非法合同 / 返回形状分别为 LOADER_CONTRACT_INVALID / ADAPTER_CONTRACT_INVALID。

rows: 必填，分别为托管 Host、输入、加载器与转换器。
必填 use 或 replace，无默认。
必填 false 或有限非负数，允许 0 / 小数；false 不设期限。
undefined，仅桥接本次事务接纳期间的取消。
undefined；诊断不能取代事务原结果。

blocks.text: loader context 提供原生 signal、deadlineAt（false 时 undefined）与 report；adapter context 提供 signal / deadlineAt。事务以 provisional scope 暂管制品，执行 load → adapt → use / replace；未 committed 则回滚，committed 后交给 exact definition generation。即使结果 ok false 或插件 blocked / failed，只要 committed true，制品仍由该代持有，后续 unUse / replace / dispose 才沿原路径释放。
取消和期限只通知协作信号，不独立阻止不合作的 loader / adapter 继续执行甚至提交；timeoutMs 必填，只有 false 才不设 deadlineAt。

成功 loadIntoHost 返回即取消本次 timer 并解除 caller signal 桥接，之后 caller abort 不影响已提交 generation 的 loader context；其 scope 仍归代际，scope 结束时 context.signal 中止。失败回滚的次要清理会报告，不替换 mutation primary；已有生命周期身份保持，不把所有清理改成本包码。

sections.id: runtime-回调使用权-取消与自变更
sections.heading: Runtime：回调使用权、取消与自变更

blocks.text: createRuntime(host, options?) 只接受托管 Host 的真实能力，借用而不销毁 Host / Graph。options.shutdown.mode 默认 strict-drain，另一个值 bounded；options.report 默认 undefined。Runtime 无 quiescenceMs；物理清理等待预算配置在托管 Host。
run(name, options, execute) 取得目标 ready 插件的 exact generation 使用权，只发布该 registration 的 extensions 快照。字面量 ready 名称可精确推导，泛化名称使用只读 unknown 记录；不是把整个 Host 扩展交给回调。

rows: 必填 false 或有限非负数，允许 0 / 小数；deadlineAt 采用 systemScheduler 的时钟。
本次递增标识与目标插件名。
当前插件代次的扩展快照。
合作式中止与单调截止点，false 时 deadlineAt 为 undefined。
只绑定当前 run、名字与 generation 的自变更能力。

blocks.text: 同步值、Promise、外来 thenable、throw / reject 都在真实 callback settlement 后释放使用权；callback 原失败保留类型、stack、identity 或 cause。signal、期限、Runtime.dispose 只中止协作信号，不抢占代码，不提前释放；回调可以忽略取消并成功返回。目标租用失败仍释放本次 deadline 任务和 caller bridge，完整的 capability / graph 等外包身份保留，不能宣称每次失败都会变成 RUNTIME_ABORTED。

dispose() 停止新 run，abort 活跃信号，复用同一个 Promise。strict-drain 等回调真实结算并报告失败；bounded 立即给出 state terminal 与 cleanupComplete 当前值，未结束回调继续受原工作持有。Runtime activeRuns 统计尚未结算的回调；Runtime.dispose 不释放借用 Host，Host 发出 disposing 时 Runtime 同样停止接纳并中止活跃信号。Symbol.asyncDispose 等待 Runtime.dispose，丢弃其返回快照。

self.unUse() / self.replace(plugin) 同步返回非 thenable ticket；操作先等 callback settle、释放使用权，再进入 canonical Host queue。ticket.completion 只在回调外读取；回调内读取会得到 RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID 的 rejected Promise，直接 await ticket 本身也不代表变更完成。替换继续按原 Host 的 core 能力准入，旧代的回执不授权变更新代。不要在 callback 捕获 concrete Host 进行自身卸载。
根入口的 defineTrayHost(definition) 创建冻结、有身份的 Host 定义；name、plugins、exposes 必填，定义阶段不调用插件工厂或 config 验证器。结构复制品没有该身份。exposes 用 plugin.feature 路径，调用用 plugin.feature.method；内部保留插件名不可作为业务暴露。

rows: 默认无；thread / process 必填 string / URL，coroutine 禁止。
默认无验证器；每次初始化校验转换输入。
每个 generation init 调用，info 含 id、host、generation 与验证后的 config。
必填只读 Feature 路径数组。
默认沿原运行时策略；可覆写 restart 与 startupTimeoutMs。
默认未指定，仅 process，包含 name 与同步 wrap(command)。
默认未指定，只读可信 policy tuple，声明子插件可用的自定义路由。

blocks.text: supervisor.restart 的 mode 可为 never / on-failure / always；还可配置 maxRestarts、windowMs、initialDelayMs。sandbox.wrap 的输入输出为完整启动命令 `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`，env 包含 inherit / set；应用自行接入外部沙箱，本包不提供沙箱实现。

coroutine 共享事件循环，停止合作式；thread 是独立 Worker isolate，process 是子进程。Node 原生入口应导入共享 Host 定义并执行 serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })；它只连接父 registry，等退出请求和插件清理后结束对应运行体，不再 spawn。Bun / Deno / browser Worker 的权限和原生退出能力不能由本地 Node 或运行时无关案例推断。

plugins 通过 Feature 引用依赖 trayPlugin.getFeature('tray')；deps.tray.self() 取身份，await deps.tray.to(host, id) 取得绑定当前接纳记录的 remote，deps.tray.exit(error?) 结束本实例。第一次 exit 决定 clean / crash，插件清理之后才结束 task / realm。根入口仅提供 ITrayClientPlugin 类型，不提供运行时 client 单例。

每实例串行管理；替换 config 仅在新 generation init 成功后提交。
只观察生命周期；watch 最近 100 条未读记录，非持久日志。
关闭注册表与所属实例，支持异步显式资源管理。

blocks.text: TrayInstanceState 为 starting / ready / restarting / failed / stopped；TrayInstanceEvent 为 spawned / ready / restarting / failed / stopped / removed。生命周期记录冻结且没有 emit；错误投影只保安全 source / code，不保证通过事件取得原 crash 对象。

remote.request / notify / stream 统一用 path、payload、第三个 options；无参数方法可省略 payload，有 options 时用 undefined 占第二位。ITrayCallOptions 仅 signal 与 timeoutMs，缺省未指定；不是把 options 塞进业务对象。业务对象里的 undefined 字段拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload / config 会省略；Uint8Array 可跨三种运行方式，非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。
父端 list / get 的 config 保留 portable 的 spawn / replace 输入；配置验证在 child init 执行，plugins(info) 与 deps.tray.self() 才读取验证器输出，该输出保持子端本地数据，不再自动转成 wire 载荷。

非 ready 目标立即 TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY；remove 后旧 remote 永久 TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN，同 id 重新 spawn 不会复活旧记录。已发送调用按原 RPC receipt 完成，不迁往新 generation。业务目标错误保留原 source / code / cause，Tray 校验与启动包装保留原 cause；inFlight 只计本接纳记录尚未结束的业务 request / notify / stream，不含 init 和主题投递。
tray.routing.roundRobin(host) 与 tray.routing('roundRobin', host) 共享同一选择序号，每次操作选择当前 ready 实例。leastInFlight 选最少待完成业务调用，平局保留 spawn 顺序；routed remote 有 host 而没有固定 id。剩余期限与取消信号交给所选目标，不自动改投其他实例或重试。

defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick) 创建有身份的冻结定义，定义时不执行 pick。name 符合 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`，不能占用内置名、函数 / 对象保留属性。pick(candidates, { host, sequence }) 在父端同步执行，收到当次独立冻结、按 spawn 顺序且反映当前 inFlight 的 ready 快照，返回其中一个 id；回调应短小。父端注册 createTray.routing 与 host DSL.routing 的合集，子插件须在自己的 host tuple 声明自定义名；只把名字跨 RPC，内置名无需声明。
未注册或未声明为 TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN；非法定义、不同 policy 身份重名、非候选返回和 pick 抛错为 TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID，原 throw 留 cause。没有 ready 候选为 TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE。
tray.publish(topic, payload?) 同步向当前订阅者分发；子端 deps.tray.publish 返回 Promise。父端 subscribe 返回同步退订函数，子端 await subscribe 返回异步幂等退订；第一位本地监听器登记父端 membership，最后一位释放时移除。重启后重新安装插件建立新代订阅，旧代操作不影响新 membership。
主题必须非空字符串，载荷必须 portable；名称 spawned 也只是业务主题，不触发生命周期事件。listener(payload, meta) 的 meta.from 由父端认证且冻结：实例为 `{ id, host, generation }`，父发布为 `{ parent: true }`；与载荷分离，载荷字段不能冒充发送者。
每个当前订阅最多投递一次；目标未 ready 会错过消息，没有 replay、持久性或业务完成确认。同步 listener throw 与异步 reject 在其侧报告，后续监听器继续；投递发送拒绝由父端报告，处理失败由子端报告，不以这些投递错误拒绝发布者。
所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `@migaia/tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

blocks.text: 安装本包；托管 Host 与运行场景直接导入 plugin-host，因此也要直接安装它。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/tray @migaia/plugin-host

blocks.text: 每个示例可独立保存为 ESM TypeScript 文件，用 Node 24 执行。示例用显式 Promise 门与生命周期结果控制顺序；不需要伪端口、浏览器全局对象或后台 Worker。生产中应沿同一 owner 的 dispose / physicalCompletion 收尾，保留 cause 和清理结果。

sections.id: 先启动依赖-再按反序释放服务
sections.heading: 先启动依赖，再按反序释放服务

blocks.text: 应用启动服务时配置还没准备好，退出时又可能先释放服务仍在使用的配置。
只靠数组顺序与分散的 finally 无法表达依赖；调整登记顺序，就可能改变启动和释放的先后。
在服务的 requires 中声明配置键。createTrayGraph 构造时不启动，ready 先启动依赖，dispose 先释放使用者，再释放提供者。

数组是 `createTrayGraph` 的唯一必填参数；`key` 是本例集中声明的 `ITrayKey`，`kind` 必填，本例分别为 `'service'` / `'value'`。`requires: [config]` 声明服务的直接依赖，省略时为空数组；`start(context)` 返回主值与可调用 `release`。`context.get<number>(config)` 的泛型只描述读取类型。未提供 `readiness`，默认无外部门；`ready()` / `dispose()` 均无参数。
输出：

blocks.code:
启动前： open 0
值： 42
start:config,start:service,release:service,release:config
之后： terminal

blocks.text: 依次输出：启动前： open 0；值： 42；start:config,start:service,release:service,release:config；之后： terminal。
配置虽然排在数组第二项，仍先启动、后释放。本例是同一运行环境内、带显式 release 回调的资源组合，不证明 Worker 或进程隔离。

sections.id: 仅重试暂时阻塞的就绪门
sections.heading: 仅重试暂时阻塞的就绪门

blocks.text: 外部提供者尚未就绪时服务不能启动，但暂时阻塞不应被当成永远无法恢复的启动失败。
一直读取同一份 blocked 快照会看到旧事实；无差别重试所有拒绝，又可能反复执行提供者已经判定失败的操作。
用 readiness getter 返回当前快照，blocked 后显式再次调用 ready；failed 是最终结果，会保留原来的拒绝 Promise。

`readiness` 省略时没有外部门；本例 getter 返回 `{ state, error }` 快照，state 只能为 `'ready'`、`'blocked'`、`'failed'`。`blocked` 的 `error` 是等待原因，不启动服务；替换为 ready 快照后显式调用 `ready()` 才重采样。另一张图用 failed 快照证明原拒绝 Promise 缓存；`error: undefined` 表示该 ready 快照无错误，不是省略必需的启动结果。
输出：

blocks.code:
阻塞： true 0
重试： ready 1 42
缓存： true
原因： true

blocks.text: 依次输出：阻塞： true 0；重试： ready 1 42；缓存： true；原因： true。
blocked 时没有启动服务，显式重试才重新采样；failed 保留同一个 Promise 与原错误。这里没有后台轮询，释放后也不能再次启动。

sections.id: 等待提供者安装后再启用依赖插件
sections.heading: 等待提供者安装后再启用依赖插件

blocks.text: 插件先于必需的提供者到达，立即安装会暴露未就绪能力；直接丢弃，又迫使调用方稍后重新拼装依赖链。
只保存插件名称列表，无法区分已登记定义与已安装的就绪插件，也无法决定提供者移除时哪些使用者必须停下。
通过 Feature 引用声明依赖。createHost 保留 blocked 使用者，use 安装提供者后恢复依赖链，unUse 移除提供者时再次阻塞使用者。

`create` 返回唯一 AppHost；原 PluginHost 的 `execution.mutationTimeoutMs` / `pipelineDrainTimeoutMs` 本例都显式设 `false`，不设相应期限。createHost 的 `create`、`plugins`、`mutationAdmissionMs`、`quiescenceMs`、`shutdown` 均必填无默认；两个预算本例为 `1000` 毫秒，`shutdown.mode: 'strict-drain'` 等实际清理，另一个可选值为 `'bounded'`。`provider.getFeature('value')` 默认必需引用，Feature 依赖映射的 `config` 键为回调依赖名；它不等于任意按插件名查找。`report` 未传，默认无自定义诊断回调。
输出：

blocks.code:
启动前： blocked 0
之后： true ready
config,screen
移除后： true blocked

blocks.text: 依次输出：启动前： blocked 0；之后： true ready；config,screen；移除后： true blocked。
阻塞中的使用者没有提前安装，提供者到达后先安装再恢复使用者。必需依赖来自 Feature 引用；本例管理一个本地 PluginHost，不证明原生宿主启动。

sections.id: 提交成功后才交接加载制品的清理责任
sections.heading: 提交成功后才交接加载制品的清理责任

blocks.text: 加载插件时还取得了资源：转换失败时必须释放，安装成功后又必须保留到对应插件移除。
把加载、转换和安装分散到独立的 try/finally，容易提前释放已提交资源，或遗漏尚未提交的资源。
通过 defineLoader、defineAdapter 与 loadIntoHost 串起事务。提交前的制品由事务暂管，转换失败会回滚，mutation 提交后才交给对应插件代次。

`host`、`source`、`loader`、`adapter`、`mutation`、`timeoutMs` 均必填；`mutation: 'use'` 安装定义，另一个值为 `'replace'`，`timeoutMs: false` 不设截止点，数值须有限非负。loader 接收数字并返回 `{ value, release: { force } }`，release 是 lifecycle descriptor；adapter 返回插件描述子。省略 `signal` 只表示没有 caller bridge，期限或 scope 仍可中止，且仅合作通知。`committed` 决定制品归属，`ok` 决定成功 view 的静态能力；创建 Host 的配置与上一场景一致。
输出：

blocks.code:
已提交： true true 0
值： 42
已释放： 1
已回滚： true ADAPTER_EXECUTION_FAILED 2

blocks.text: 依次输出：已提交： true true 0；值： 42；已释放： 1；已回滚： true ADAPTER_EXECUTION_FAILED 2。
成功后资源保留到 unUse，转换失败则释放本次资源并保留原 TypeError。清理责任取决于 committed，不能只看 ok；实际工作未结束或清理自身失败时，还需观察后续清理结果。

sections.id: 取消后仍等待回调实际结束
sections.heading: 取消后仍等待回调实际结束

blocks.text: 调用方取消任务时，回调可能仍在使用插件能力；若立即宣告完成，清理就会碰到回调仍持有的资源。
Promise 竞速只能停止等待，不能终止同一运行环境里的用户代码，也无法证明它已经释放资源。
通过 createRuntime 运行并传入调用者 signal。回调收到合作式取消信号，但所属插件代次仍保留到回调完成；本例显式打开 Promise 门，让工作正常结束。

`createRuntime(host)` 默认 `shutdown.mode: 'strict-drain'`，`report` 默认未传；它借用 Host。`run('billing', { signal, timeoutMs: false }, callback)` 的三项必填，`signal` 可省略，`timeoutMs` 必须为 false 或有限非负数。`extensions` 只含 billing 当前安装的能力，`signal` 是原生合作信号；本例通过显式 Promise 门确定工作何时结束，不使用计时猜测。原 Host 配置同前，`Runtime.dispose()` 不替代 `Host.dispose()`。
输出：

blocks.code:
值： 42
已取消： true true 1
结果： 已完成 0
宿主： active

blocks.text: 依次输出：值： 42；已取消： true true 1；结果： 已完成 0；宿主： active。
取消保留原始原因，在回调实际完成前仍有一个活动运行；回调仍可成功返回。Runtime 释放不负责关闭借用的 Host，截止时间同样只发出取消信号，不会抢占用户代码。

sections.id: 回调结束后再卸载当前插件
sections.heading: 回调结束后再卸载当前插件

blocks.text: 一次性插件返回结果后想卸载自己；若在回调内部等待普通卸载，卸载可能又在等待该回调释放自身代次。
捕获原始 Host 会绕开当前代次能力；把变更回执当成普通 Promise，也会模糊何时才能安全开始清理。
在回调中返回 self.unUse() 的 ticket，等 run 完成后再读取 ticket.completion。Runtime 先释放回调占用的代次，再提交对应代次的变更。

原 Host 的 `plugins` tuple 安装 oneShot；`install(core)` 的 core 提供 `onDispose`，不是 Host handle。`runtime.run` 的 `timeoutMs: false` 必填，默认没有 caller signal；`self.unUse()` 无参数，绑定本次运行的名字和安装代次，`self.replace(plugin)` 是另一个选择。回调返回 ticket 后，外层才读其 `completion`；ticket 没有 then，不是等待变更完成的 Promise。`createRuntime` 仍默认 strict-drain，Host 各必填预算配置同前。
输出：

blocks.code:
值： 42
凭据： false 0
移除后： false 1

blocks.text: 依次输出：值： 42；凭据： false 0；移除后： false 1。
回执不是类 Promise 对象，外层 completion 在回调结束后观察到一次插件清理。在该回调内部读取 completion 会以 RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID 拒绝；Runtime 和 Host 仍需分别释放。
Tray 组合已有的能力与生命周期，不另建一套协议。静态 Graph 管理同一运行环境内、构造前已知的完整资源集合；托管 Host 组合 PluginHost 定义；根入口的 Hosts 注册表管理独立实例。能力依赖由 capability 负责，插件安装由 plugin-host 负责，连接和原生执行由 RPC / supervision 负责；这些依赖图不等于响应式数据依赖。

rows: createTrayGraph；defineTrayHost、createTray、serveTrayHost；路由策略与实例状态、公开错误。
createHost 与托管 Host 的公开类型。
createRuntime 与回调运行、协作取消、自变更回执类型。

blocks.text: Loader、Adapter、Runtime 不从根入口聚合。直接导入 plugin-host、lifecycle 等依赖的示例应直接安装这些包。本包运行时依赖 capability、event-subscriber、lifecycle、plugin-host、rpc-contract、rpc-core、rpc-process、rpc-threads、supervision 与 utils。跨机器发现、浏览器 Worker 接入、UI、持久消息与自动故障转移重试不属于这里的组合保证。
`createTrayGraph(entries)` 必填一个完整只读数组，构造时同步检查但不启动。ITrayKey 是带品牌的字符串，运行时要求 trim 后非空；业务应集中定义并复用键，不依赖库猜测或生成。

rows: 必填且全数组唯一；重复键为 TRAY_DUPLICATE_ENTRY。
必填，value / computed / resource / service；只是类别标签，不改变 value 的静态类型或自动创建响应式能力。
默认空数组；只能引用本次集合的其他键，不允许自身或未知键。
默认 undefined；外部就绪快照，state 为 ready / blocked / failed。
必填函数；依赖就绪后收到 context，返回或 resolve 为完整的 `{ value, release }`。

blocks.text: key、kind、requires、readiness、start 的入场读取与依赖检查都在第一个 start 之前；异常或外形非法为 TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY。规范化后的 keys / requires 数组冻结，调用方后续修改原数组不会改变拓扑。readiness 属性值在入场捕获，首次 gate 使用该对象；这不是对任意业务值或快照对象做深克隆。

context.signal 在 Graph 关闭时中止；context.get(key) 只读取已声明、已就绪的直接依赖；context.own(resource, descriptor) 把辅助资源交给当前节点，完整 release descriptor 沿 lifecycle 处理。start 的主值 release(context) 接收 Graph 释放上下文，可同步返回或返回类 Promise 对象。部分构造失败时，entry 自己回滚尚未交出的资源。

第一次 ready() 按 entry 顺序检查入场捕获快照的 state / error；全缺省或 ready 才启动 Graph。blocked / failed 拒绝其 error，null / undefined 时使用 TRAY_UNAVAILABLE，其他假值仍是原失败。非法 state 为 TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY，之后不读取该快照的 error；getter 失败尽可能保留原生类型 / identity 并附 TRAY_GATE_READ_FAILED。
只有 blocked 允许下一次显式 ready() 重新读取各 entry.readiness 及新快照；提供 getter 才能取得提供者后来发布的新对象。failed、非法快照、getter 失败及 Graph 启动结果缓存同一个 Promise；启动成功后不再采样外部门，dispose 后不再重试。没有自动轮询或重试计时。

rows: 冻结的入场键列表，保持声明顺序。
ready 前为 open；gate 失败投影 failed，之后沿 Graph 状态与原错误。
无参数，显式门控并启动依赖；保留最终 Promise 身份。
只在 Graph 与节点可见时读 Graph 自己的 value；未知键 TRAY_UNKNOWN_ENTRY，其余不可用为 TRAY_UNAVAILABLE。
读取单个节点状态，未知键同样拒绝。

blocks.text: 失败结果的 committed 表示候选是否已经成为当前 binding，不能用 ok 或“同名还存在”猜测。未提交 duplicate / cycle / replacement 候选回滚，不成为后来重启的隐式来源。真正 unUse 后原排序位置永久退休，同名后续 use 获得新的单调位置；provider 恢复与同名 replace 保留已有 definition 的位置。

成功结果携带 result.view；检查 ok 后把该 view 交给 createRuntime，才能延续新插件精确扩展类型。原 Host 变量的静态类型不会自动改变。ITrayResolvedHost 对有限、literal、最多 128 个定义且 provider/name 未泛化的 tuple 求 ready 闭包；超出预算或名称泛化使用 ITrayHostDynamic，保留 constructor baseline，未知动态键为 unknown。

Host.state 可为 active / closing / terminal / failed；失败时 facade.state 可为 failed，而返回清理结果仍标记 state terminal。工厂失败的 creation detail 带阶段与清理信息；phase 类型包含 factory / admission / graph / setup / commit，当前实际观察路径使用 factory / setup，不承诺逐项发出所有阶段。重复认领已在使用的 Host 只回滚本次 claim，不销毁已有会话；冻结 factory 异常通过 cause 保留，避免 detail 附加覆盖原错。绕过 facade 使用逃逸的 concrete Host 变更，会以 HOST_MUTATION_BYPASS 关闭后续可信访问。

Host mutation / disposal 的 ICleanupResult 来自 lifecycle：cleanupErrors 是当前快照，cleanupComplete false 表示仍需观察同一个 physicalCompletion，其结果只包含后来新增的错误。用 `mergeCleanupResults([result])` 合并当前及所有后续增量，包括跨运行环境的 Promise。

Graph 在释放 exact generation 前封闭该 binding 的新使用权，再等已取得使用权的工作结束；PluginHost 先等待这道屏障，再按使用者 / 提供者、插件 / 资源顺序清理。Host 的 bounded 可按 quiescenceMs 返回逻辑结果，strict-drain 等实际完成。原 PluginHost 必填 execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 为数值时，共享本批预算到期后继续后续清理；false 才逐项等真实完成。预算不会取消仍在运行的 Promise，迟到工作与错误继续由 physicalCompletion 观察。
托管 Host 支持异步显式资源管理；环境不支持 await using 时，在 finally 中 await host.dispose()。不要把 cleanupComplete false 当成全部资源已释放，也不要丢弃物理结果。

defineLoader({ load }) 捕获一次 load 方法，返回冻结合同；每次 load(source, context) 调用该函数一次，接受同步、Promise 与外来类 Promise 对象。defineAdapter({ adapt }) 同样捕获转换方法并在每次 adapt 时调用；它们不创建 Host / Graph，也不独自接管制品清理。独立包装器保留执行结果，事务中的失败分类由 loadIntoHost 负责。
load 的结果须含 value 与 lifecycle release descriptor，至少有可调用 force；与静态 entry 的 release 函数不是同一外形。adapter 将 value 转成与原 Host core 兼容的插件描述子。非法合同 / 返回形状分别为 LOADER_CONTRACT_INVALID / ADAPTER_CONTRACT_INVALID。

blocks.text: loader context 提供原生 signal、deadlineAt（false 时 undefined）与 report；adapter context 提供 signal / deadlineAt。事务以 provisional scope 暂管制品，执行 load → adapt → use / replace；未 committed 则回滚，committed 后交给 exact definition generation。即使结果 ok false 或插件 blocked / failed，只要 committed true，制品仍由该代持有，后续 unUse / replace / dispose 才沿原路径释放。
取消和期限只通知协作信号，不独立阻止不合作的 loader / adapter 继续执行甚至提交；timeoutMs 必填，只有 false 才不设 deadlineAt。

成功 loadIntoHost 返回即取消本次 timer 并解除 caller signal 桥接，之后 caller abort 不影响已提交 generation 的 loader context；其 scope 仍归代际，scope 结束时 context.signal 中止。失败回滚的次要清理会报告，不替换 mutation primary；已有生命周期身份保持，不把所有清理改成本包码。

blocks.text: createRuntime(host, options?) 只接受托管 Host 的真实能力，借用而不销毁 Host / Graph。options.shutdown.mode 默认 strict-drain，另一个值 bounded；options.report 默认 undefined。Runtime 无 quiescenceMs；物理清理等待预算配置在托管 Host。
run(name, options, execute) 取得目标 ready 插件的 exact generation 使用权，只发布该 registration 的 extensions 快照。字面量 ready 名称可精确推导，泛化名称使用只读 unknown 记录；不是把整个 Host 扩展交给回调。

rows: 必填 false 或有限非负数，允许 0 / 小数；deadlineAt 采用 systemScheduler 的时钟。
本次递增标识与目标插件名。
当前插件代次的扩展快照。
合作式中止与单调截止点，false 时 deadlineAt 为 undefined。

blocks.text: 同步值、Promise、外来 thenable、throw / reject 都在真实 callback settlement 后释放使用权；callback 原失败保留类型、stack、identity 或 cause。signal、期限、Runtime.dispose 只中止协作信号，不抢占代码，不提前释放；回调可以忽略取消并成功返回。目标租用失败仍释放本次 deadline 任务和 caller bridge，完整的 capability / graph 等外包身份保留，不能宣称每次失败都会变成 RUNTIME_ABORTED。

dispose() 停止新 run，abort 活跃信号，复用同一个 Promise。strict-drain 等回调真实结算并报告失败；bounded 立即给出 state terminal 与 cleanupComplete 当前值，未结束回调继续受原工作持有。Runtime activeRuns 统计尚未结算的回调；Runtime.dispose 不释放借用 Host，Host 发出 disposing 时 Runtime 同样停止接纳并中止活跃信号。Symbol.asyncDispose 等待 Runtime.dispose，丢弃其返回快照。

self.unUse() / self.replace(plugin) 同步返回非 thenable ticket；操作先等 callback settle、释放使用权，再进入 canonical Host queue。ticket.completion 只在回调外读取；回调内读取会得到 RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID 的 rejected Promise，直接 await ticket 本身也不代表变更完成。替换继续按原 Host 的 core 能力准入，旧代的回执不授权变更新代。不要在 callback 捕获 concrete Host 进行自身卸载。
根入口的 defineTrayHost(definition) 创建冻结、有身份的 Host 定义；name、plugins、exposes 必填，定义阶段不调用插件工厂或 config 验证器。结构复制品没有该身份。exposes 用 plugin.feature 路径，调用用 plugin.feature.method；内部保留插件名不可作为业务暴露。

blocks.text: supervisor.restart 的 mode 可为 never / on-failure / always；还可配置 maxRestarts、windowMs、initialDelayMs。sandbox.wrap 的输入输出为完整启动命令 `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`，env 包含 inherit / set；应用自行接入外部沙箱，本包不提供沙箱实现。

coroutine 共享事件循环，停止合作式；thread 是独立 Worker isolate，process 是子进程。Node 原生入口应导入共享 Host 定义并执行 serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? })；它只连接父 registry，等退出请求和插件清理后结束对应运行体，不再 spawn。Bun / Deno / browser Worker 的权限和原生退出能力不能由本地 Node 或运行时无关案例推断。

blocks.text: createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? }) 返回 ITray；hosts 必填为可信定义数组，routing 与每个定义的 policy 合并。probe 默认未指定，可为单个 IRpcProbe 或只读数组；createTray.report 默认 Core 的 defaultRpcReporter。serveTrayHost 使用相同 probe / report 类型，默认 report 为 console.error。

blocks.text: TrayInstanceState 为 starting / ready / restarting / failed / stopped；TrayInstanceEvent 为 spawned / ready / restarting / failed / stopped / removed。生命周期记录冻结且没有 emit；错误投影只保安全 source / code，不保证通过事件取得原 crash 对象。

remote.request / notify / stream 统一用 path、payload、第三个 options；无参数方法可省略 payload，有 options 时用 undefined 占第二位。ITrayCallOptions 仅 signal 与 timeoutMs，缺省未指定；不是把 options 塞进业务对象。业务对象里的 undefined 字段拒绝，只有 wire envelope 的 absent payload / config 会省略；Uint8Array 可跨三种运行方式，非 portable config 在创建连接前拒绝。
父端 list / get 的 config 保留 portable 的 spawn / replace 输入；配置验证在 child init 执行，plugins(info) 与 deps.tray.self() 才读取验证器输出，该输出保持子端本地数据，不再自动转成 wire 载荷。

非 ready 目标立即 TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY；remove 后旧 remote 永久 TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN，同 id 重新 spawn 不会复活旧记录。已发送调用按原 RPC receipt 完成，不迁往新 generation。业务目标错误保留原 source / code / cause，Tray 校验与启动包装保留原 cause；inFlight 只计本接纳记录尚未结束的业务 request / notify / stream，不含 init 和主题投递。
tray.routing.roundRobin(host) 与 tray.routing('roundRobin', host) 共享同一选择序号，每次操作选择当前 ready 实例。leastInFlight 选最少待完成业务调用，平局保留 spawn 顺序；routed remote 有 host 而没有固定 id。剩余期限与取消信号交给所选目标，不自动改投其他实例或重试。

defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick) 创建有身份的冻结定义，定义时不执行 pick。name 符合 `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$`，不能占用内置名、函数 / 对象保留属性。pick(candidates, { host, sequence }) 在父端同步执行，收到当次独立冻结、按 spawn 顺序且反映当前 inFlight 的 ready 快照，返回其中一个 id；回调应短小。父端注册 createTray.routing 与 host DSL.routing 的合集，子插件须在自己的 host tuple 声明自定义名；只把名字跨 RPC，内置名无需声明。
未注册或未声明为 TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN；非法定义、不同 policy 身份重名、非候选返回和 pick 抛错为 TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID，原 throw 留 cause。没有 ready 候选为 TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE。
tray.publish(topic, payload?) 同步向当前订阅者分发；子端 deps.tray.publish 返回 Promise。父端 subscribe 返回同步退订函数，子端 await subscribe 返回异步幂等退订；第一位本地监听器登记父端 membership，最后一位释放时移除。重启后重新安装插件建立新代订阅，旧代操作不影响新 membership。
主题必须非空字符串，载荷必须 portable；名称 spawned 也只是业务主题，不触发生命周期事件。listener(payload, meta) 的 meta.from 由父端认证且冻结：实例为 `{ id, host, generation }`，父发布为 `{ parent: true }`；与载荷分离，载荷字段不能冒充发送者。
每个当前订阅最多投递一次；目标未 ready 会错过消息，没有 replay、持久性或业务完成确认。同步 listener throw 与异步 reject 在其侧报告，后续监听器继续；投递发送拒绝由父端报告，处理失败由子端报告，不以这些投递错误拒绝发布者。
所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `@migaia/tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

Start and release resources by dependency while giving plugin installation, loaded artifacts and active callbacks one observable lifecycle.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A service starts before its configuration, then loses that configuration during shutdown because ordering exists only in arrays and scattered finally blocks.
A temporarily unavailable provider never recovers because code keeps reading an old snapshot without distinguishing blocked from final failure.
A plugin arrives before its provider and exposes half-ready behavior because registration and installation were combined.
Conversion leaks a resource or successful installation frees it too soon because loading, conversion and installation own separate cleanup paths.
Cancellation is reported as completion while the callback still uses resources because stopping the wait was mistaken for stopping code.

Let dependencies determine both startup and release. Static composition uses Capability Graph, and Start dependencies before consumers and release them last registers resources in reverse order while still starting configuration first and releasing the service first.

Recover explicitly from temporary blocks while keeping final failure stable. Readiness getters are resampled only after blocked, and Retry a blocked readiness gate without retrying a failed gate checks both no premature startup and cached failed-Promise identity.

Keep plugin definitions while they wait for missing providers. Managed Host uses Feature references to retain blocked definitions, and Keep a dependent plugin blocked until its provider is installed starts the consumer when its provider arrives and blocks it when that provider leaves.

Transfer loaded-resource cleanup according to commitment. loadIntoHost provisionally owns the artifact until committed, and Transfer loaded artifact cleanup only when admission commits checks delayed release after success and rollback after conversion failure.

Keep resources leased until cancelled callbacks actually settle. Runtime retains the current installation's usage lease, and Keep a cancelled callback alive until it really settles observes one active run after cancellation and zero only after callback settlement.

blocks.text: Tray composes existing capabilities and lifecycle owners rather than adding another protocol. A static Graph manages a complete, known collection of resources in one realm. A managed Host composes PluginHost definitions, while the root Hosts registry manages independent instances. Capability owns dependency graphs, plugin-host owns plugin installation, and RPC/supervision own connections and native execution. Capability dependencies are distinct from reactive data dependencies.

rows: createTrayGraph; defineTrayHost, createTray, serveTrayHost; routing policies, instance states and public errors.

blocks.text: Loader, Adapter and Runtime are not aggregated by the root. Directly imported dependencies such as plugin-host or lifecycle should be installed directly. Runtime dependencies are capability, event-subscriber, lifecycle, plugin-host, rpc-contract, rpc-core, rpc-process, rpc-threads, supervision and utils. Cross-machine discovery, browser Worker integration, UI, durable messages and automatic failover retry are outside these composition guarantees.

`createTrayGraph(entries)` requires one complete readonly array. Construction validates synchronously without starting entries. ITrayKey is a branded string, requiring non-whitespace content at runtime; declare and reuse application keys centrally rather than expecting the library to infer or generate them.

rows: Required and unique in the array; duplicate keys reject with TRAY_DUPLICATE_ENTRY.
Required: value / computed / resource / service; a category label, without changing value's static type or automatically creating reactive behavior.
Defaults to an empty array; refers only to other keys in this collection, excluding self and unknown keys.

blocks.text: Admission reads key, kind, requires, readiness and start and validates dependencies before the first start. Invalid structure or read failure rejects with TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY. Normalized keys/requires arrays are frozen, so later mutation of the original arrays cannot change topology. Admission captures the readiness property value and the initial gate uses that object; this does not deep-clone arbitrary application values or snapshot objects.

context.signal aborts when the Graph closes. context.get(key) reads declared, ready direct dependencies, and context.own(resource, descriptor) transfers auxiliary-resource ownership to the current node with the complete lifecycle release descriptor. The primary value's release(context) receives Graph release context and may be synchronous or thenable. An entry must roll back resources acquired before handing over a complete result if construction fails.

The first ready() checks state/error on admitted snapshots in entry order. Only omitted or ready facts allow Graph startup. Blocked/failed reject their error, using TRAY_UNAVAILABLE for null/undefined while preserving other falsey failures. Invalid state rejects with TRAY_INVALID_ENTRY without reading that snapshot's error. Getter failures preserve native type/identity where possible and receive TRAY_GATE_READ_FAILED.

Only blocked permits a later explicit ready() to reacquire each entry.readiness and its current snapshot. Use a getter to obtain newly published objects. Failed, malformed snapshots, getter failures and the Graph startup result keep the same Promise. Success stops further external sampling, and disposal prevents retry. There is no automatic polling or retry timer.

open before ready; failed gate projection, then the Graph's state and original error.
No arguments; gates and starts dependencies, retaining final Promise identity.
Reads the Graph's own visible value; TRAY_UNKNOWN_ENTRY for unknown keys and TRAY_UNAVAILABLE for other unavailable states.
Reads one node's state, rejecting unknown keys.
No arguments; revokes visibility and releases consumers before providers under Graph idempotency and Promise identity.

blocks.text: There is no second Tray value table. Startup, a later node's failure and shutdown do not expose partially started values. Both the primary and context.own resources belong to the node, so callers should not release them again. Graph retains primary and cleanup failures through cause/errors. Tray adds no timeout, scheduler or forced termination; same-realm start/release callbacks that never settle can keep waiting.

sections.heading: Managed Host construction, mutation and types

blocks.text: Import `await createHost(options)` from /host. create() constructs the sole concrete PluginHost class instance or defineHost() handle. Its facade retains the original Host identity, domain core, pipeline and constructor baseline. Plugin install(core) receives domain core and lifecycle core rather than the Host handle.

Required initial definition tuple without a default; admitted together and started by Feature dependencies.
Required finite non-negative millisecond budget for serialized graph-mutation admission.
Required finite non-negative budget for bounded physical-cleanup waiting.

blocks.text: Tray uses Features, config and disposer from the same PluginHost admission snapshot. Its public dependency reader builds the dynamic graph before publishing ready definitions. Missing required providers leave definitions blocked. Missing optional providers do not block; present optional providers still install first. Dependencies come from Feature references rather than legacy plugin-dependency fields. Invalid descriptors reject before graph mutation with the PluginHost cause preserved; failures after graph mutation are observed through mutation results.

Unknown names return blocked without providing extensions.
Retain the original Host baseline and ready-plugin surface.
Adds a definition, which can be committed but blocked.
Replaces the exact same-name generation while retaining its ordering slot.
Deletes a definition and blocks its consumer closure; unknown names return ok true / committed false / removed false.
Ends the graph, removes its internal anchor and cleans the concrete Host; concurrent and synchronous reentrant calls share one Promise.

blocks.text: Committed indicates whether the exact candidate became the current binding. Neither ok nor the continued existence of a name determines that fact. Uncommitted duplicate, cycle or replacement candidates roll back without becoming a later restart source. True unUse permanently retires the ordering slot; later same-name use receives a new monotonic slot. Provider recovery and same-name replace retain the definition's existing slot.

Successful results carry result.view. Check ok and pass that view into createRuntime to retain newly installed extension types. The previous Host variable's static type does not change automatically. ITrayResolvedHost computes an exact ready closure for finite literal tuples of at most 128 definitions without widened names/providers. Larger or widened cases use ITrayHostDynamic, retaining the constructor baseline and unknown for unrecognized dynamic keys.

Host.state can be active / closing / terminal / failed. Cleanup failure can leave facade.state failed while its returned disposal result still says state terminal. Creation failures carry detail with cleanup information and a phase type of factory / admission / graph / setup / commit; current observed creation paths use factory/setup, without promising every typed phase will be emitted. A duplicate claim rolls back only the new claim rather than destroying an existing session. Frozen factory errors remain reachable through cause instead of being hidden by detail annotation. Mutating an escaped concrete Host bypasses the facade and fails subsequent trusted access with HOST_MUTATION_BYPASS.

Managed mutations/disposal use lifecycle's ICleanupResult. cleanupErrors is the current snapshot. cleanupComplete false requires observing the same physicalCompletion, whose result contains only later incremental errors. Use `mergeCleanupResults([result])` to combine current and later errors, including cross-realm Promises.

Before releasing an exact generation, Graph seals new binding leases and waits for existing users. PluginHost waits for that fence before consumer/provider and plugin/resource cleanup. Managed bounded shutdown can return logically after quiescenceMs; strict-drain awaits physical settlement. The original required execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs is a shared numeric batch budget after which later cleanup proceeds; false waits for actual completion item by item. A budget does not cancel pending Promises. physicalCompletion continues observing unfinished work and late errors.

Managed Host supports asynchronous explicit resource management. Where await using is unavailable, await host.dispose() in finally. cleanupComplete false does not mean all resources are released, and physical results must remain observed.

defineLoader({ load }) captures load once and returns a frozen contract. Each load(source, context) invokes that captured function once, accepting synchronous values, Promises and foreign thenables. defineAdapter({ adapt }) similarly captures its method and invokes it on each conversion. Neither creates a Host/Graph nor independently owns artifact cleanup. Standalone wrappers retain execution results; loadIntoHost owns transaction-phase error classification.

A loaded result requires value and a lifecycle release descriptor with callable force. This differs from a static entry's release function. The adapter converts value into a plugin descriptor compatible with the original Host core. Invalid contracts/results receive LOADER_CONTRACT_INVALID / ADAPTER_CONTRACT_INVALID as appropriate.

blocks.text: Loader context provides native signal, deadlineAt (undefined for false), and report. Adapter context provides signal/deadlineAt. A provisional scope owns the artifact during load → adapt → use/replace. An uncommitted mutation rolls it back; a committed definition generation assumes custody. Even ok false or blocked/failed plugins keep their artifacts when committed is true, until later unUse/replace/dispose releases that generation.

Cancellation and deadlines notify cooperative signals rather than independently preventing an uncooperative loader/adapter from continuing or committing. timeoutMs is required; only false disables deadlineAt.

Successful loadIntoHost return cancels its timer and removes the caller-signal bridge. Later caller abort cannot affect the committed generation's loader context. Its scope remains generation-owned and aborts context.signal when it ends. Secondary rollback failures are reported without replacing the mutation primary. Existing lifecycle identities remain unchanged rather than all becoming Tray cleanup codes.

createRuntime(host, options?) accepts the actual managed-Host capability and borrows its Host/Graph. options.shutdown.mode defaults to strict-drain, with bounded as the other value. options.report defaults to undefined. Runtime has no quiescenceMs; physical-cleanup waiting budgets belong to managed Host options.

run(name, options, execute) acquires a ready plugin's exact-generation lease and publishes only that registration's extension snapshot. Literal ready names retain exact inference; widened names yield a readonly unknown record rather than the entire Host extension surface.

blocks.text: Synchronous values, Promises, foreign thenables and thrown/rejected callbacks release their lease only at actual callback settlement. Signals, deadlines and Runtime.dispose abort cooperative signals without preempting code or releasing early; a callback may ignore cancellation and return successfully. Failed lease admission releases the deadline task and caller bridge. Complete capability/graph error identities remain unchanged, so not every admission failure becomes RUNTIME_ABORTED.

dispose() stops new runs, aborts active signals and shares one Promise. Strict-drain awaits real settlement and reports callback failures. Bounded returns a terminal result immediately with the current cleanupComplete value while outstanding callbacks retain their existing ownership. activeRuns counts unsettled callbacks. Runtime.dispose does not dispose its borrowed Host. Host disposing also retires Runtime admission and aborts active signals. Symbol.asyncDispose awaits Runtime.dispose and discards its result snapshot.

self.unUse() / self.replace(plugin) return a non-thenable ticket synchronously. The mutation waits for callback settlement and lease release before entering the canonical Host queue. Read ticket.completion outside the callback: an internal read returns a rejected Promise with RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID. Awaiting the ticket itself does not await mutation. Replacement still checks the original Host core, and an old-generation ticket does not authorize a new generation. Avoid capturing concrete Host to remove the executing plugin.

The root defineTrayHost(definition) creates a frozen, branded definition. name, plugins and exposes are required; definition does not invoke the plugin factory or config validator. Structural copies lack its identity. exposes uses plugin.feature paths, and calls use plugin.feature.method. Reserved internal plugin names cannot be exposed as business plugins.

Coroutine shares the event loop and stops cooperatively. Thread uses a separate Worker isolate; process uses a child process. A Node native entry imports a shared Host definition and calls serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? }). It connects to the parent registry rather than spawning again, and waits for shutdown and plugin cleanup before ending that runtime. Local Node or runtime-neutral examples do not establish Bun/Deno/browser Worker permissions or native-exit capabilities.

First exit determines clean versus crash, after PluginHost cleanup and before task/realm termination. The root exports ITrayClientPlugin only as a type without a runtime client singleton.

createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? }) returns ITray. Hosts is a required trusted-definition array; routing combines shared policies with every Host declaration. blocks.text: TrayInstanceState is starting / ready / restarting / failed / stopped. TrayInstanceEvent is spawned / ready / restarting / failed / stopped / removed. Lifecycle records are frozen and there is no emit. Their safe error projection contains source/code rather than promising the original crash object.

Remote request/notify/stream use path, payload and third-position options. Empty methods may omit payload; use undefined in the second position when passing options. ITrayCallOptions contains only signal and timeoutMs, both unspecified by default. Undefined application-object fields reject; only absent payload/config in the wire envelope is omitted. Uint8Array works across all three families, and non-portable config rejects before connection creation.

Parent list/get config retains the portable spawn/replace input. Validation runs during child init; plugins(info) and deps.tray.self() receive that validator output locally, without another automatic wire conversion.

Non-ready targets reject with TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY. Removed admissions permanently reject old remotes with TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN; spawning the same id cannot revive them. Already-sent calls finish through their original RPC receipt rather than moving to a new generation. Business errors retain source/code/cause, and Tray validation/start wrappers retain original causes. inFlight counts pending business request/notify/stream for this admission, excluding initialization and topic delivery.

tray.routing.roundRobin(host) and tray.routing('roundRobin', host) share one sequence and choose a currently ready instance per operation. leastInFlight selects the fewest pending business calls with spawn-order ties. A routed remote has host without a fixed id. Remaining deadlines and cancellation reach the selected target, without automatic failover or retry.

defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick) creates a trusted frozen identity without invoking pick. Names match `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$` and cannot use built-ins or reserved function/object properties. pick(candidates, { host, sequence }) runs synchronously in the parent against a fresh frozen ready snapshot in spawn order with current inFlight, returning one candidate id. Keep it short. Parent registration combines createTray({ routing }) and Host DSL routing declarations; child plugins declare custom names in their own tuple. Only names cross RPC, and built-ins need no declaration.

Unknown or undeclared policies reject with TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN. Invalid definitions, equal names from different policy identities, non-candidate results and thrown pickers reject with TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID, preserving the thrown cause. No ready candidates rejects with TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE.

Parent tray.publish(topic, payload?) returns synchronously; child deps.tray.publish returns a Promise. Parent subscribe returns a synchronous unsubscribe function. Awaited child subscribe returns an asynchronous idempotent receipt: the first local listener registers parent membership and the last release removes it. Reinstalled plugins subscribe in the new generation after restart, without old-generation operations changing that membership.

Topics require non-empty strings and portable payloads. A topic named spawned remains a business topic without triggering lifecycle listeners. Listener(payload, meta) receives parent-authenticated frozen meta.from: `{ id, host, generation }` for an instance and `{ parent: true }` for parent publication. It is separate from arbitrary payload fields, which cannot impersonate the sender.

Each current subscription receives at most one delivery. Non-ready subscribers miss publications, with no replay, persistence or business-completion acknowledgement. Synchronous listener throws and async rejections are reported on their own side while later listeners continue. Delivery-send rejection is reported by the parent and handler failure by the child, without those delivery failures rejecting the publisher.

Tray-owned boundary codes use TRAY_SOURCE, `@migaia/tray`. Branch on source/code rather than message. Annotatable native errors preserve type, stack and identity. Frozen or unsafe-to-annotate values remain reachable through a coded wrapper's cause, and complete foreign identities remain with their owner. Graph startup, node and release failures continue to belong to capability.

Loader/Adapter method getters are read once, and validation/execution use that same function.

The module provides fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and build. Preserve cause/errors and physicalCompletion when recording cleanup failures. This command list does not claim execution here, nor establish other hosts, native isolation or performance from local examples.

Choose a complete task below, then consult the static-resource graph, managed-plugin, loading and instance-registry contracts. These examples use real Tray, PluginHost and Runtime objects in one realm. They do not establish Worker, process, sandbox or cross-machine execution.

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/tray @migaia/plugin-host

blocks.text: Each example can be saved as a separate ESM TypeScript file and run with Node 24. Explicit Promise gates and lifecycle results control ordering without fake ports, browser globals or background Workers. In production, finish cleanup through the same owner using dispose/physicalCompletion and retain causes and cleanup results.

sections.heading: Start dependencies before consumers and release them last

blocks.text: An application starts a service before its configuration is available, or tears down configuration while the service still uses it.
Array order and scattered finally blocks do not describe dependencies; changing registration order can change which resource survives a failure.
Declare the service's config key in requires. createTrayGraph does not start during construction; ready starts dependencies first and dispose releases consumers before providers.

The complete entry array is createTrayGraph's one required argument. Keys are centrally declared branded strings; kind is required and uses 'service'/'value' here. requires declares the service's direct config dependency and defaults to an empty array. Start returns a value and callable release. The context.get type argument describes the read statically. Readiness is omitted, so there is no external gate. Ready and dispose take no arguments.
Output:

blocks.code:
before: open 0
value: 42
start:config,start:service,release:service,release:config
after: terminal

blocks.text: Output: before: open 0; value: 42; start:config,start:service,release:service,release:config; after: terminal.

The dependency starts first despite being listed second, and is released last. These are same-realm resources with explicit release callbacks; this example does not demonstrate Worker or process isolation.

sections.heading: Retry a blocked readiness gate without retrying a failed gate

blocks.text: A service cannot start until an external provider becomes ready, but a temporary block should not be treated as a permanently failed startup.
Polling a captured blocked object keeps reading old facts, while retrying every rejected Promise can rerun a failure the provider has declared final.
Return current snapshots from the readiness getter and call ready again after a blocked result. A failed snapshot is final and retains its rejected Promise.

Omitting readiness supplies no external gate. This getter returns a state/error snapshot, with state limited to ready, blocked or failed. The blocked error preserves the reason without starting the service; replacing the snapshot only takes effect through another explicit ready call. A separate failed graph checks cached rejection identity. Error undefined means the ready snapshot has no error, without removing the requirement for a complete start result.
Output:

blocks.code:
blocked: true 0
retry: ready 1 42
cached: true
cause: true

blocks.text: Output: blocked: true 0; retry: ready 1 42; cached: true; cause: true.
Blocked readiness starts nothing and can be sampled again explicitly. Failed readiness keeps one Promise and the original error. No timer polls the provider, and disposal prevents later retries.

sections.heading: Keep a dependent plugin blocked until its provider is installed

blocks.text: A plugin arrives before its required provider. Installing it immediately exposes a half-ready feature; discarding it forces the caller to reconstruct the dependency chain later.
A list of plugin names cannot distinguish a registered definition from an installed, ready plugin or explain which consumer must stop when a provider leaves.
Declare the dependency with a Feature reference. createHost retains the blocked consumer; use installs the provider and reconciles its consumers, while unUse blocks them again.

Create returns the sole AppHost. Its PluginHost execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs are explicitly false, disabling those deadlines. CreateHost requires create, plugins, mutationAdmissionMs, quiescenceMs and shutdown without defaults. Both budgets are 1000 milliseconds here. Strict-drain awaits physical cleanup; bounded is the other mode. Provider.getFeature('value') is required by default, and config in the Feature dependency map names that dependency. Report is omitted, with no custom diagnostic callback.
Output:

blocks.code:
before: blocked 0
after: true ready
config,screen
removed: true blocked

blocks.text: Output: before: blocked 0; after: true ready; config,screen; removed: true blocked.

The blocked consumer was not installed early; the provider installs first when it arrives. Required dependencies come from Feature references. This is one local managed PluginHost, not a native-host launch.

sections.heading: Transfer loaded artifact cleanup only when admission commits

blocks.text: Loading a plugin also acquires a resource. If conversion fails, that resource must be released; after a successful install it must stay alive until that exact plugin is removed.
Splitting load, conversion and installation across independent try/finally blocks can free a committed resource early or leak an uncommitted one.
Use defineLoader and defineAdapter with loadIntoHost. The transaction owns the provisional artifact, rolls it back on conversion failure, and transfers custody on a committed mutation.

Host, source, loader, adapter, mutation and timeoutMs are required. Mutation use installs a definition, with replace as the alternative. TimeoutMs false disables its deadline; numeric values must be finite and non-negative. Loader returns a numeric value and lifecycle release descriptor with force; adapter returns a plugin descriptor. An omitted signal removes only the caller bridge, not deadline/scope cancellation, which remains cooperative. Committed determines custody, while ok determines successful-view typing. Host construction uses the same explicit options as above.
Output:

blocks.code:
committed: true true 0
value: 42
released: 1
rolled back: true ADAPTER_EXECUTION_FAILED 2

blocks.text: Output: committed: true true 0; value: 42; released: 1; rolled back: true ADAPTER_EXECUTION_FAILED 2.

Success retains the artifact until unUse, while adapter failure releases its artifact and preserves the TypeError. Custody follows committed, not merely ok; cleanup can be deferred by active work or fail separately.

sections.heading: Keep a cancelled callback alive until it really settles

blocks.text: A caller cancels a task while its callback is still using plugin extensions. Reporting it as finished immediately lets cleanup run against resources the callback still holds.
Promise races only stop waiting; they do not stop same-realm user code or prove it has released its resources.

Run through createRuntime with a caller signal. The callback receives a cooperative signal, and its generation remains leased until the callback settles; this example releases a Promise gate explicitly.

CreateRuntime(host) defaults to shutdown.mode strict-drain and no report callback, borrowing the Host. Run requires the name, options and callback. Signal is optional, while timeoutMs is required false or a finite non-negative number. Extensions exposes only the current billing installation; signal is native and cooperative. An explicit Promise gate determines completion without a timing assumption. Host construction uses the same options as above, and Runtime.dispose does not replace Host.dispose.
Output:

blocks.code:
value: 42
aborted: true true 1
result: settled 0
host: active

blocks.text: Output: value: 42; aborted: true true 1; result: settled 0; host: active.

Cancellation preserves the reason and leaves one active run until actual settlement. A callback may still return successfully. Runtime disposal does not dispose its borrowed Host; deadlines also signal cancellation rather than preempting code.

sections.heading: Remove the current plugin after its callback releases the lease

blocks.text: A one-shot plugin wants to remove itself after returning a result. Waiting for ordinary removal inside its own callback can wait on the callback's own generation lease.
Capturing the raw Host bypasses the current generation capability, while treating a mutation receipt as an ordinary Promise hides when cleanup may safely start.
Return self.unUse's ticket from the callback, then await ticket.completion outside run. Runtime releases the callback lease before submitting that exact-generation mutation.

The Host plugins tuple installs oneShot. Its install core supplies onDispose rather than being the Host handle. Run requires timeoutMs false and has no caller signal by default. Self.unUse takes no arguments and is bound to this run's name/generation; self.replace(plugin) is the replacement alternative. Return the ticket and read completion outside the callback. It has no then and does not itself await mutation. Runtime still defaults to strict-drain, and Host budgets remain explicit as above.
Output:

blocks.code:
value: 42
ticket: false 0
removed: false 1

blocks.text: Output: value: 42; ticket: false 0; removed: false 1.

The ticket is not thenable, and its outer completion observes one plugin cleanup after the callback ends. Reading completion inside that callback rejects RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID. Runtime and Host still need separate disposal.

Reads one node's state, rejecting unknown keys.
No arguments; revokes visibility and releases consumers before providers under Graph idempotency and Promise identity.

blocks.text: There is no second Tray value table. Startup, a later node's failure and shutdown do not expose partially started values. Both the primary and context.own resources belong to the node, so callers should not release them again. Graph retains primary and cleanup failures through cause/errors. Tray adds no timeout, scheduler or forced termination; same-realm start/release callbacks that never settle can keep waiting.

sections.heading: Managed Host construction, mutation and types

blocks.text: Import `await createHost(options)` from /host. create() constructs the sole concrete PluginHost class instance or defineHost() handle. Its facade retains the original Host identity, domain core, pipeline and constructor baseline. Plugin install(core) receives domain core and lifecycle core rather than the Host handle.

rows: Required without a default; returns an original Host not already claimed by another Tray session.
Required initial definition tuple without a default; admitted together and started by Feature dependencies.
Required finite non-negative millisecond budget for serialized graph-mutation admission.
Required finite non-negative budget for bounded physical-cleanup waiting.
Required without a default: bounded or strict-drain.
undefined; receives contained lifecycle and cleanup diagnostics.

blocks.text: Tray uses Features, config and disposer from the same PluginHost admission snapshot. Its public dependency reader builds the dynamic graph before publishing ready definitions. Missing required providers leave definitions blocked. Missing optional providers do not block; present optional providers still install first. Dependencies come from Feature references rather than legacy plugin-dependency fields. Invalid descriptors reject before graph mutation with the PluginHost cause preserved; failures after graph mutation are observed through mutation results.

rows: All admitted definition names versus ready names only.
Unknown names return blocked without providing extensions.
Retain the original Host baseline and ready-plugin surface.
Adds a definition, which can be committed but blocked.
Replaces the exact same-name generation while retaining its ordering slot.
Deletes a definition and blocks its consumer closure; unknown names return ok true / committed false / removed false.
Ends the graph, removes its internal anchor and cleans the concrete Host; concurrent and synchronous reentrant calls share one Promise.

blocks.text: Committed indicates whether the exact candidate became the current binding. Neither ok nor the continued existence of a name determines that fact. Uncommitted duplicate, cycle or replacement candidates roll back without becoming a later restart source. True unUse permanently retires the ordering slot; later same-name use receives a new monotonic slot. Provider recovery and same-name replace retain the definition's existing slot.

Successful results carry result.view. Check ok and pass that view into createRuntime to retain newly installed extension types. The previous Host variable's static type does not change automatically. ITrayResolvedHost computes an exact ready closure for finite literal tuples of at most 128 definitions without widened names/providers. Larger or widened cases use ITrayHostDynamic, retaining the constructor baseline and unknown for unrecognized dynamic keys.

Host.state can be active / closing / terminal / failed. Cleanup failure can leave facade.state failed while its returned disposal result still says state terminal. Creation failures carry detail with cleanup information and a phase type of factory / admission / graph / setup / commit; current observed creation paths use factory/setup, without promising every typed phase will be emitted. A duplicate claim rolls back only the new claim rather than destroying an existing session. Frozen factory errors remain reachable through cause instead of being hidden by detail annotation. Mutating an escaped concrete Host bypasses the facade and fails subsequent trusted access with HOST_MUTATION_BYPASS.

Managed mutations/disposal use lifecycle's ICleanupResult. cleanupErrors is the current snapshot. cleanupComplete false requires observing the same physicalCompletion, whose result contains only later incremental errors. Use `mergeCleanupResults([result])` to combine current and later errors, including cross-realm Promises.

Before releasing an exact generation, Graph seals new binding leases and waits for existing users. PluginHost waits for that fence before consumer/provider and plugin/resource cleanup. Managed bounded shutdown can return logically after quiescenceMs; strict-drain awaits physical settlement. The original required execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs is a shared numeric batch budget after which later cleanup proceeds; false waits for actual completion item by item. A budget does not cancel pending Promises. physicalCompletion continues observing unfinished work and late errors.

Managed Host supports asynchronous explicit resource management. Where await using is unavailable, await host.dispose() in finally. cleanupComplete false does not mean all resources are released, and physical results must remain observed.

defineLoader({ load }) captures load once and returns a frozen contract. Each load(source, context) invokes that captured function once, accepting synchronous values, Promises and foreign thenables. defineAdapter({ adapt }) similarly captures its method and invokes it on each conversion. Neither creates a Host/Graph nor independently owns artifact cleanup. Standalone wrappers retain execution results; loadIntoHost owns transaction-phase error classification.

A loaded result requires value and a lifecycle release descriptor with callable force. This differs from a static entry's release function. The adapter converts value into a plugin descriptor compatible with the original Host core. Invalid contracts/results receive LOADER_CONTRACT_INVALID / ADAPTER_CONTRACT_INVALID as appropriate.

rows: Required managed Host, input source, loader and converter.
Required use or replace, without a default.
Required false or finite non-negative number, including zero/fractions; false disables the deadline.
undefined; bridged only during this transaction's admission.
undefined; diagnostics cannot replace its primary result.

blocks.text: Loader context provides native signal, deadlineAt (undefined for false), and report. Adapter context provides signal/deadlineAt. A provisional scope owns the artifact during load → adapt → use/replace. An uncommitted mutation rolls it back; a committed definition generation assumes custody. Even ok false or blocked/failed plugins keep their artifacts when committed is true, until later unUse/replace/dispose releases that generation.

Cancellation and deadlines notify cooperative signals rather than independently preventing an uncooperative loader/adapter from continuing or committing. timeoutMs is required; only false disables deadlineAt.

Successful loadIntoHost return cancels its timer and removes the caller-signal bridge. Later caller abort cannot affect the committed generation's loader context. Its scope remains generation-owned and aborts context.signal when it ends. Secondary rollback failures are reported without replacing the mutation primary. Existing lifecycle identities remain unchanged rather than all becoming Tray cleanup codes.

createRuntime(host, options?) accepts the actual managed-Host capability and borrows its Host/Graph. options.shutdown.mode defaults to strict-drain, with bounded as the other value. options.report defaults to undefined. Runtime has no quiescenceMs; physical-cleanup waiting budgets belong to managed Host options.

run(name, options, execute) acquires a ready plugin's exact-generation lease and publishes only that registration's extension snapshot. Literal ready names retain exact inference; widened names yield a readonly unknown record rather than the entire Host extension surface.

rows: Required false or finite non-negative number, including zero/fractions; deadlineAt uses systemScheduler's clock.
Incrementing run identifier and target plugin name.
Cooperative cancellation and monotonic deadline; deadlineAt is undefined for false.
Self-mutation capability bound to this run, name and generation.

blocks.text: Synchronous values, Promises, foreign thenables and thrown/rejected callbacks release their lease only at actual callback settlement. Callback failures preserve native type, stack, identity or cause. Signals, deadlines and Runtime.dispose abort cooperative signals without preempting code or releasing early; a callback may ignore cancellation and return successfully. Failed lease admission releases the deadline task and caller bridge. Complete capability/graph error identities remain unchanged, so not every admission failure becomes RUNTIME_ABORTED.

dispose() stops new runs, aborts active signals and shares one Promise. Strict-drain awaits real settlement and reports callback failures. Bounded returns a terminal result immediately with the current cleanupComplete value while outstanding callbacks retain their existing ownership. activeRuns counts unsettled callbacks. Runtime.dispose does not dispose its borrowed Host. Host disposing also retires Runtime admission and aborts active signals. Symbol.asyncDispose awaits Runtime.dispose and discards its result snapshot.

self.unUse() / self.replace(plugin) return a non-thenable ticket synchronously. The mutation waits for callback settlement and lease release before entering the canonical Host queue. Read ticket.completion outside the callback: an internal read returns a rejected Promise with RUNTIME_CONTRACT_INVALID. Awaiting the ticket itself does not await mutation. Replacement still checks the original Host core, and an old-generation ticket does not authorize a new generation. Avoid capturing concrete Host to remove the executing plugin.

The root defineTrayHost(definition) creates a frozen, branded definition. name, plugins and exposes are required; definition does not invoke the plugin factory or config validator. Structural copies lack its identity. exposes uses plugin.feature paths, and calls use plugin.feature.method. Reserved internal plugin names cannot be exposed as business plugins.

rows: Absent by default; required string/URL for thread/process and prohibited for coroutine.
No validator by default; validates and converts input for every initialization.
Called per generation init with id, host, generation and validated config.
Original runtime policy by default; restart and startupTimeoutMs can override it.
Unspecified, process only, with name and synchronous wrap(command).
Unspecified trusted readonly policy tuple declaring custom policies available to child plugins.

blocks.text: supervisor.restart.mode accepts never / on-failure / always; maxRestarts, windowMs and initialDelayMs are also configurable. sandbox.wrap receives and returns the complete launch command `{ command, args, cwd?, env }`, where env contains inherit/set. Applications supply an external sandbox; Tray provides no sandbox implementation.

Coroutine shares the event loop and stops cooperatively. Thread uses a separate Worker isolate; process uses a child process. A Node native entry imports a shared Host definition and calls serveTrayHost(host, { probe?, report? }). It connects to the parent registry rather than spawning again, and waits for shutdown and plugin cleanup before ending that runtime. Local Node or runtime-neutral examples do not establish Bun/Deno/browser Worker permissions or native-exit capabilities.

Plugins declare a Feature dependency on trayPlugin.getFeature('tray'). deps.tray.self() returns identity, await deps.tray.to(host, id) returns an admission-bound remote, and deps.tray.exit(error?) ends the instance. First exit determines clean versus crash, after PluginHost cleanup and before task/realm termination. The root exports ITrayClientPlugin only as a type without a runtime client singleton.

createTray({ hosts, routing?, probe?, report? }) returns ITray. Hosts is a required trusted-definition array; routing combines shared policies with every Host declaration. Probe defaults to unspecified and accepts one IRpcProbe or a readonly array. createTray.report defaults to Core's defaultRpcReporter. serveTrayHost accepts the same probe/report types and defaults report to console.error.

rows: Initializes and returns the typed remote; config is required when its inferred configuration type excludes undefined.
Synchronously obtains a remote bound to one admission.
Frozen snapshots; omitted filters impose no restriction.
Asynchronously merges RPC unit detail while retaining Tray's numeric generation.
graceMs defaults to 5000; attempts child PluginHost cleanup before stopping, reporting failure/timeout and continuing.
Per-instance serialized management; replacement config commits only after new-generation init succeeds.
Lifecycle observation only; watch retains the latest 100 unread records rather than a durable log.
Closes the registry and owned instances, with asynchronous explicit resource management.

blocks.text: TrayInstanceState is starting / ready / restarting / failed / stopped. TrayInstanceEvent is spawned / ready / restarting / failed / stopped / removed. Lifecycle records are frozen and there is no emit. Their safe error projection contains source/code rather than promising the original crash object.

Remote request/notify/stream use path, payload and third-position options. Empty methods may omit payload; use undefined in the second position when passing options. ITrayCallOptions contains only signal and timeoutMs, both unspecified by default. Undefined application-object fields reject; only absent payload/config in the wire envelope is omitted. Uint8Array works across all three families, and non-portable config rejects before connection creation.

Parent list/get config retains the portable spawn/replace input. Validation runs during child init; plugins(info) and deps.tray.self() receive that validator output locally, without another automatic wire conversion.

Non-ready targets reject with TRAY_INSTANCE_NOT_READY. Removed admissions permanently reject old remotes with TRAY_INSTANCE_UNKNOWN; spawning the same id cannot revive them. Already-sent calls finish through their original RPC receipt rather than moving to a new generation. Business errors retain source/code/cause, and Tray validation/start wrappers retain original causes. inFlight counts pending business request/notify/stream for this admission, excluding initialization and topic delivery.

tray.routing.roundRobin(host) and tray.routing('roundRobin', host) share one sequence and choose a currently ready instance per operation. leastInFlight selects the fewest pending business calls with spawn-order ties. A routed remote has host without a fixed id. Remaining deadlines and cancellation reach the selected target, without automatic failover or retry.

defineRoutingPolicy(name, pick) creates a trusted frozen identity without invoking pick. Names match `^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$` and cannot use built-ins or reserved function/object properties. pick(candidates, { host, sequence }) runs synchronously in the parent against a fresh frozen ready snapshot in spawn order with current inFlight, returning one candidate id. Keep it short. Parent registration combines createTray({ routing }) and Host DSL routing declarations; child plugins declare custom names in their own tuple. Only names cross RPC, and built-ins need no declaration.

Unknown or undeclared policies reject with TRAY_ROUTING_UNKNOWN. Invalid definitions, equal names from different policy identities, non-candidate results and thrown pickers reject with TRAY_ROUTING_INVALID, preserving the thrown cause. No ready candidates rejects with TRAY_HOST_UNAVAILABLE.

Parent tray.publish(topic, payload?) returns synchronously; child deps.tray.publish returns a Promise. Parent subscribe returns a synchronous unsubscribe function. Awaited child subscribe returns an asynchronous idempotent receipt: the first local listener registers parent membership and the last release removes it. Reinstalled plugins subscribe in the new generation after restart, without old-generation operations changing that membership.

Topics require non-empty strings and portable payloads. A topic named spawned remains a business topic without triggering lifecycle listeners. Listener(payload, meta) receives parent-authenticated frozen meta.from: `{ id, host, generation }` for an instance and `{ parent: true }` for parent publication. It is separate from arbitrary payload fields, which cannot impersonate the sender.

Each current subscription receives at most one delivery. Non-ready subscribers miss publications, with no replay, persistence or business-completion acknowledgement. Synchronous listener throws and async rejections are reported on their own side while later listeners continue. Delivery-send rejection is reported by the parent and handler failure by the child, without those delivery failures rejecting the publisher.

Tray-owned boundary codes use TRAY_SOURCE, `@migaia/tray`. Branch on source/code rather than message. Annotatable native errors preserve type, stack and identity. Frozen or unsafe-to-annotate values remain reachable through a coded wrapper's cause, and complete foreign identities remain with their owner. Graph startup, node and release failures continue to belong to capability.

Topic is not a non-empty string.

blocks.text: Four former public managed-type helpers are no longer exported: IHostBaselinePlugins, IPluginWithSynchronousShared, ICanResolveReadyDefinitions and IResolveReadyTrayPlugins. Use ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic or inferred Runtime types externally. Runtime shutdown accepts only mode; its unused quiescenceMs field was removed, with that budget configured on managed Host instead. Loader/Adapter method getters are read once, and validation/execution use that same function.

The module provides fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and build. Preserve cause/errors and physicalCompletion when recording cleanup failures. This command list does not claim execution here, nor establish other hosts, native isolation or performance from local examples.

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `@migaia/tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
keys: Frozen admitted keys in declaration order.
state: `open` before `ready()`; then the graph state; `failed` when a gate failed.
error: The current gate or graph error, unchanged.
ready: Checks every `readiness` gate, then starts the entries in dependency order. A `blocked` gate can be retried by calling `ready()` again; other results are cached.
Resolves when every entry is ready; rejects with the gate or start error.
get: Reads the value of a ready entry.
get.key: An admitted `ITrayKey`, usually from your key constants.
The value; unknown keys throw `TRAY_UNKNOWN_ENTRY`, not ready throws `TRAY_UNAVAILABLE`.
entryState: Returns the graph state of one entry.
entryState.key: An admitted `ITrayKey`.
The node state, such as `ready` or `failed`.
dispose: Stops admission and releases every entry in reverse dependency order; repeated calls share the result.
Resolves after release; release errors keep the original failure reachable.

blocks.text: 所有 Tray 自有边界码的 source 为 TRAY_SOURCE，即 `@migaia/tray`；按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message。可注记的原生错误保持类型、stack 与 identity；冻结或不可安全注记的值经带码 wrapper.cause 保留，完整外包身份不改写。Graph 启动 / 节点 / 释放错误继续属于 capability。

rows: 没有 ready 路由候选。
policy 未注册或子端未声明。
policy 名称 / 回调 / 返回候选无效或执行抛错。
Host DSL 或 registry 构造输入无效。
remote 指向与当前接纳记录不同的 Host。
暴露路径使用保留内部插件名。
config 或 payload 不是支持的 portable 数据。
spawn 重用仍被接纳的 id。
lookup 或 remote 使用已结束接纳记录。
插件安装或 generation init 失败，原因留 cause。
调用路径不在声明暴露面。
child init 重复或引用其他 Host。
已关闭 registry 继续接纳操作。
Loader / result / release 外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 loader 执行失败。
Adapter 或插件返回外形非法。
加载事务内未归属的 adapter 执行失败。
Runtime Host / 参数 / callback 或 self ticket 使用违约。
Runtime 关闭后继续接纳 run。
未归属的 callback throw / reject，使用权仍在结算后释放。
运行租用接纳失败的回退分类；完整外包身份保留，信号取消不强制 reject。
未归属的制品次要清理失败；不替换 mutation primary。
静态 entry、托管 factory 返回或 Host claim 非法。
静态 Graph 重复 key。
get / entryState 使用未接纳 key。
Graph 或 entry 未 ready、gate 失败或已终结。
readiness 属性或 state/error getter 失败。
绕开托管 facade 的 concrete Host 变更。

blocks.text: 旧四个托管类型辅助导出 IHostBaselinePlugins、IPluginWithSynchronousShared、ICanResolveReadyDefinitions、IResolveReadyTrayPlugins 已取消公开导出；外部标注使用 ITrayResolvedHost / ITrayHostDynamic 或 Runtime 推导。Runtime shutdown 只接收 mode，不再接收未使用的 quiescenceMs；对应预算在 managed Host 配置。Loader / Adapter 方法只读取一次，校验与执行复用同一函数。
包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build；清理失败需沿 cause / errors 与 physicalCompletion 记录。此命令清单不声明本页已运行门禁，也不把本地案例当成其他运行时、原生隔离或性能证据。

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
methods: Method paths callable on the other side, from its accepted directory.
counters: Call counters: `inFlight` (calls not yet finished) is measured; `sent`, `received`, `errors`, `lastActiveAt` are reported unavailable; or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
recent: Recent lifecycle records (`IRuntimeRecent`), newest last.
identity: Identity `{ name, instanceId }` the other side announced, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
generation: Number of the current initialisation; it grows on every restart, replace or supervised restart.
kind: How the connection was configured: `spawn`, `connect` or `listen`.
direction: Who started it: `spawned`, `spawned-by` (this side is the child), `connect` or `listen`.
carrier: Name of the physical carrier, such as a MessagePort or stdio.
connection: `{ status }`: `ready`, `closed`, `departed`, or unavailable.
unit: Supervised unit `{ kind, state, generation, degraded }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
health: Health check metric `{ state, failures }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
restartCount: Number of restarts as a metric, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
resources: Sampled resources (pid or threadId, memory, CPU time, event-loop utilisation), or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
lastExit: Last exit `{ generation, reason, code, signal, error? }`, or `{ status: "unavailable", reason }` when the owner cannot observe it.
id: Instance id given to `spawn(host, { id })`.
host: Name of the host definition the instance runs.
config: Inside plugins(instance) and the child client self(), config is the validator output, or the input without a validator. Parent list/get snapshots instead retain the portable spawn/replace input; they do not publish the transformed child value.
runtime: How the instance runs: `coroutine`, `thread` or `process`.
state: Registry state of the instance.
inFlight: Business calls (`request`, `notify`, `stream`) sent to this admission and not finished; `leastInFlight` routing compares it.
